source.text: וְזֶ֨ה הַדָּבָ֜ר אֲשֶֽׁר־תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה לָהֶ֛ם לְקַדֵּ֥שׁ אֹתָ֖ם לְכַהֵ֣ן לִ֑י לְ֠קַח פַּ֣ר אֶחָ֧ד בֶּן־בָּקָ֛ר וְאֵילִ֥ם שְׁנַ֖יִם תְּמִימִֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And this [is] the thing which you will do to them to consecrate them to serve as priests to me: take one young bull, a son of [the] herd, and two rams, unblemished,

en.L: And this [is] the thing that you shall do to them to consecrate them to serve as priests to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}: take one bull, a son of the herd, and two rams without blemish,
en.B: Here is what you are to do to consecrate them as {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} priests: take one young bull and two rams with no defect,
en.R: This is how you must set Aaron and his sons apart to serve {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} as priests. Take one young bull and two rams. The animals must have nothing wrong with them.

es.L: Y esto [es] lo que les harás para consagrarlos, para que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} sirvan como sacerdotes: toma un novillo, cría de la vacada, y dos carneros sin defecto,
es.B: Esto es lo que harás para consagrarlos como {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} sacerdotes: toma un novillo y dos carneros sin defecto,
es.R: Así es como debes apartar a Aarón y a sus hijos para que {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} sirvan como sacerdotes. Toma un novillo y dos carneros. Los animales no deben tener ningún defecto.

fr.L: Et voici la chose que tu leur feras pour les consacrer, afin qu’ils exercent le sacerdoce pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} : prends un taureau, un petit du gros bétail, et deux béliers sans défaut,
fr.B: Voici ce que tu feras pour les consacrer comme {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prêtres : prends un jeune taureau et deux béliers sans défaut,
fr.R: Voici comment tu dois mettre à part Aaron et ses fils pour qu’ils {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} servent comme prêtres. Prends un jeune taureau et deux béliers. Ces animaux ne doivent avoir aucun défaut.

sw.L: Na hili [ndilo] jambo utakalowafanyia ili kuwatakasa wanitumikie katika ukuhani: chukua fahali mmoja, ndama wa ng'ombe, na kondoo dume wawili wasio na kasoro,
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo utakavyowatakasa ili wawe makuhani {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}: chukua fahali mchanga mmoja na kondoo dume wawili wasio na kasoro,
sw.R: Hivi ndivyo utakavyowatenga Haruni na wanawe ili wanitumikie kama makuhani. Chukua fahali mchanga mmoja na kondoo dume wawili. Wanyama hao wasiwe na kasoro yoyote.

decisions.choice: consecrate: make holy, set apart for God
decisions.reason: The verb means to make something or someone holy, that is, to set it apart as belonging to God and fit for his service. The rites of this chapter carry out the command of 28:41.

decisions.choice: them: Aaron and his sons
decisions.reason: The chapter goes on from the garments of chapter 28, which ends with Aaron and his sons (28:41-43). Verse 4 names them.

decisions.choice: a son of the herd ... unblemished: a young bull, and animals sound and whole
decisions.reason: "Son of the herd" means a young animal from the cattle. "Unblemished" means whole, with no defect, as every animal offered to God had to be (12:5; Leviticus 22:19-22).

decisions.choice: Aaron and his sons
decisions.reason: Readable names the people meant by "them" and puts the requirement about the animals in a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: "kuwatakasa" (L, B); "kuwatenga" (R)
decisions.reason: As in Exodus 19, "consecrate" is "kutakasa", to make holy, at Literal and Balanced; Readable says "kuwatenga", set them apart, as the English Readable does.

source.text: וְלֶ֣חֶם מַצּ֗וֹת וְחַלֹּ֤ת מַצֹּת֙ בְּלוּלֹ֣ת בַּשֶּׁ֔מֶן וּרְקִיקֵ֥י מַצּ֖וֹת מְשֻׁחִ֣ים בַּשָּׁ֑מֶן סֹ֥לֶת חִטִּ֖ים תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: and bread of unleavened [loaves] and cakes of unleavened [bread] mixed with oil and wafers of unleavened [bread] smeared with oil; [of] fine flour of wheats you will make them.

en.L: and bread of unleavened [loaves], and unleavened ring-cakes mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers spread with oil; of fine flour of wheat you shall make them.
en.B: and unleavened bread, with unleavened loaves that have oil mixed in and thin unleavened wafers spread with oil. Use fine wheat flour for all of them.
en.R: Also get unleavened bread, made without yeast. Make some loaves with olive oil mixed into the dough, and some thin wafers with oil spread on top. Use the best wheat flour.

es.L: y pan sin levadura, y tortas sin levadura en forma de anillo, amasadas con aceite, y obleas sin levadura untadas con aceite; de flor de harina de trigo las harás.
es.B: y pan sin levadura, con panes sin levadura amasados con aceite y obleas delgadas sin levadura untadas con aceite. Hazlo todo con flor de harina de trigo.
es.R: Consigue también pan hecho sin levadura. Haz unos panes con aceite de oliva mezclado en la masa, y unas obleas delgadas con aceite untado por encima. Usa la mejor harina de trigo.

fr.L: et du pain sans levain, et des gâteaux sans levain en forme d’anneau, pétris à l’huile, et des galettes sans levain enduites d’huile ; tu les feras de fleur de farine de blé.
fr.B: et du pain sans levain, avec des pains sans levain pétris à l’huile et de fines galettes sans levain enduites d’huile. Pour tout cela, utilise de la fleur de farine de blé.
fr.R: Prends aussi du pain sans levain, c’est-à-dire fait sans levure. Fais des pains avec de l’huile d’olive mélangée à la pâte, et de fines galettes avec de l’huile étalée dessus. Utilise la meilleure farine de blé.

sw.L: na mkate usiotiwa chachu, na mikate ya mviringo isiyotiwa chachu iliyochanganywa na mafuta, na mikate myembamba isiyotiwa chachu iliyopakwa mafuta; utaifanya kwa unga laini wa ngano.
sw.B: na mkate usiotiwa chachu, pamoja na mikate isiyotiwa chachu iliyokandwa kwa mafuta, na mikate myembamba isiyotiwa chachu iliyopakwa mafuta. Itengeneze yote kwa unga laini wa ngano.
sw.R: Pata pia mkate usiotiwa chachu, yaani uliotengenezwa bila hamira. Tengeneza mikate kadhaa yenye mafuta ya zeituni yaliyochanganywa katika unga, na mikate myembamba iliyopakwa mafuta juu yake. Tumia unga bora wa ngano.

decisions.choice: cakes: ring-shaped or pierced loaves
decisions.reason: The word comes from a root meaning to pierce, and probably names a round loaf with a hole in it or one pricked through. It was a thicker loaf than the wafer.

decisions.choice: smeared: spread with oil
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for anointing (verse 7). The thin wafers had oil brushed over them, while the loaves had oil mixed into the dough.

decisions.choice: fine flour: finely ground flour, the best
decisions.reason: The word names flour ground fine, the kind used for offerings and for honored guests (Genesis 18:6; Leviticus 2:1).

decisions.choice: olive oil ... made without yeast
decisions.reason: The oil of the offerings was olive oil (27:20; verse 40), so Readable says so, and it explains "unleavened" as the style guide sets.

decisions.choice: "gâteaux ... en forme d'anneau" (L), "pains" (B, R); "galettes" for the wafers
decisions.reason: Literal follows the English "ring-cakes"; Balanced and Readable say "pains" for the thicker loaves and keep "galettes" for the thin wafers, as in Leviticus 2. "Sans levain" at every level; Readable adds "fait sans levure" to explain it.

source.text: וְנָתַתָּ֤ אוֹתָם֙ עַל־סַ֣ל אֶחָ֔ד וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם בַּסָּ֑ל וְאֶ֨ת־הַפָּ֔ר וְאֵ֖ת שְׁנֵ֥י הָאֵילִֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will put them on one basket and bring them near in the basket, and the young bull and the two rams.

en.L: And you shall put them in one basket, and you shall bring them near in the basket, and the bull and the two rams.
en.B: Place them all in a single basket and present them in it, along with the bull and the two rams.
en.R: Put all the bread in one basket. Bring the basket as an offering, together with the bull and the two rams.

es.L: Y los pondrás en un canastillo, y los presentarás en el canastillo, junto con el novillo y los dos carneros.
es.B: Colócalos todos en un mismo canastillo y preséntalos en él, junto con el novillo y los dos carneros.
es.R: Pon todo el pan en un solo canastillo. Lleva el canastillo como ofrenda, junto con el novillo y los dos carneros.

fr.L: Et tu les mettras dans une seule corbeille, et tu les feras approcher dans la corbeille, ainsi que le taureau et les deux béliers.
fr.B: Place-les tous dans une même corbeille et présente-les dans celle-ci, avec le taureau et les deux béliers.
fr.R: Mets tout le pain dans une seule corbeille. Apporte la corbeille en offrande, avec le taureau et les deux béliers.

sw.L: Nawe utaiweka katika kikapu kimoja, na kuisogeza katika kikapu hicho, pamoja na fahali na kondoo dume wawili.
sw.B: Iweke yote katika kikapu kimoja na kuileta ndani yake, pamoja na fahali na kondoo dume wawili.
sw.R: Weka mikate yote katika kikapu kimoja. Kilete kikapu hicho kama sadaka, pamoja na fahali na kondoo dume wawili.

decisions.choice: bring near: present before God, offer
decisions.reason: The verb means to bring something close, and it is the usual word for presenting an offering to God (Leviticus 1:2-3). The same verb is used for bringing Aaron and his sons forward in verses 4 and 8.

decisions.choice: Bring the basket as an offering
decisions.reason: Readable spells out that "bring near" means to present it as an offering.

source.text: וְאֶת־אַהֲרֹ֤ן וְאֶת־בָּנָיו֙ תַּקְרִ֔יב אֶל־פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְרָחַצְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם בַּמָּֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And Aaron and his sons you will bring near to [the] entrance of [the] tent of meeting and wash them with water.

en.L: And Aaron and his sons you shall bring near to the entrance of the tent of meeting, and you shall wash them with water.
en.B: Next, have Aaron and his sons come forward to the doorway of the tent of meeting, and bathe them with water.
en.R: Have Aaron and his sons come to the door of the tent of meeting. Use water to wash them.

es.L: Y a Aarón y a sus hijos los harás acercarse a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro, y los lavarás con agua.
es.B: Después haz que Aarón y sus hijos se acerquen a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro, y báñalos con agua.
es.R: Haz que Aarón y sus hijos vengan a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro. Lávalos con agua.

fr.L: Et Aaron et ses fils, tu les feras approcher de l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre, et tu les laveras avec de l’eau.
fr.B: Ensuite, fais avancer Aaron et ses fils jusqu’à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre, et baigne-les dans l’eau.
fr.R: Fais venir Aaron et ses fils à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre. Lave-les avec de l’eau.

sw.L: Na Haruni na wanawe utawasogeza mpaka mlango wa Hema la Kukutania, na kuwaosha kwa maji.
sw.B: Kisha walete Haruni na wanawe mbele kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania, uwaoshe kwa maji.
sw.R: Walete Haruni na wanawe kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania. Waoshe kwa maji.

decisions.choice: tent of meeting: the tabernacle, where God meets his people
decisions.reason: The tent is named for its purpose: there God meets with Moses and with Israel (verses 42-43; 25:22). The rites take place at its entrance, in the courtyard, where the people could gather (Leviticus 8:3-4).

decisions.choice: wash: a washing that makes them clean before they are dressed
decisions.reason: Washing with water comes first, before the holy garments are put on (Leviticus 8:6; 16:4). The priests are to wash again whenever they serve (30:19-21).

source.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ אֶת־הַבְּגָדִ֗ים וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֤ אֶֽת־אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶת־הַכֻּתֹּ֔נֶת וְאֵת֙ מְעִ֣יל הָאֵפֹ֔ד וְאֶת־הָאֵפֹ֖ד וְאֶת־הַחֹ֑שֶׁן וְאָפַדְתָּ֣ ל֔וֹ בְּחֵ֖שֶׁב הָאֵפֹֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will take the garments and clothe Aaron [with] the tunic and the robe of the ephod and the ephod and the breastpiece, and gird [the ephod] to him with the band of the ephod.

en.L: And you shall take the garments and clothe Aaron [with] the tunic, and the robe of the ephod, and the ephod, and the breastpiece; and you shall gird him with the band of the ephod.
en.B: Then take the priestly garments and put them on Aaron: the tunic, the robe that goes under the ephod, the ephod, and the breastpiece. Tie the ephod around him with its woven band.
en.R: Take the special clothes and dress Aaron in them. Put on him the tunic, the robe, the ephod and the breastpiece. Tie the ephod in place with its belt.

es.L: Y tomarás las vestiduras, y vestirás a Aarón [con] la túnica, y el manto del efod, y el efod, y el pectoral; y lo ceñirás con la banda del efod.
es.B: Luego toma las vestiduras sacerdotales y pónselas a Aarón: la túnica, el manto que va debajo del efod, el efod y el pectoral. Átale el efod con su banda tejida.
es.R: Toma la ropa especial y viste con ella a Aarón. Ponle la túnica, el manto, el efod y el pectoral. Sujeta el efod con su cinturón.

fr.L: Et tu prendras les vêtements, et tu revêtiras Aaron de la tunique, et de la robe de l’éphod, et de l’éphod, et du pectoral ; et tu le ceindras de la bande de l’éphod.
fr.B: Puis prends les vêtements sacerdotaux et mets-les à Aaron : la tunique, la robe qui se porte sous l’éphod, l’éphod et le pectoral. Attache l’éphod autour de lui avec sa bande tissée.
fr.R: Prends les vêtements spéciaux et habille Aaron avec. Mets-lui la tunique, la robe, l’éphod et le pectoral. Attache l’éphod avec sa ceinture.

sw.L: Nawe utayachukua mavazi, na kumvika Haruni kanzu, na joho la efodi, na efodi, na kifuko cha kifuani; na kumfunga [efodi] kwa ukanda wa efodi.
sw.B: Kisha chukua mavazi ya kikuhani umvike Haruni: kanzu, joho linalovaliwa chini ya efodi, efodi na kifuko cha kifuani. Mfungie efodi kwa ukanda wake uliofumwa.
sw.R: Chukua mavazi maalum umvike Haruni. Mvike kanzu, joho, efodi na kifuko cha kifuani. Funga efodi kwa mshipi wake.

decisions.choice: the garments: the holy garments made for Aaron in chapter 28
decisions.reason: The garments are the ones God described in chapter 28 (28:2-4), made "for glory and for beauty". They are put on him here in the order of dressing, from the inner tunic outward.

decisions.choice: gird with the band: fasten the ephod with its woven waistband
decisions.reason: The verb is formed from the word "ephod" itself and means to tie the ephod on. The band was woven of the same materials as the ephod and fastened it at the waist (28:8).

decisions.choice: priestly garments / special clothes; the robe that goes under the ephod
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what kind of garments these are. Balanced explains "robe of the ephod" as the robe worn under it (28:31); Readable shortens it to "the robe" and calls the band a belt.

decisions.choice: "la tunique", "la robe", "la bande (tissée)" of the ephod; "ceinture" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced call the woven waistband of the ephod "la bande", keeping "ceinture" for the sash of verse 9; Readable follows the English "belt" with "ceinture".

decisions.choice: "kanzu", "joho", "ukanda" (L, B), "mshipi" (R)
decisions.reason: "Kanzu" is the long inner tunic and "joho" the outer robe. The ephod's woven band is "ukanda" at Literal and Balanced (as in 28:8), apart from the sash ("mshipi") of verse 9; Readable follows the English "belt".

source.text: וְשַׂמְתָּ֥ הַמִּצְנֶ֖פֶת עַל־רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וְנָתַתָּ֛ אֶת־נֵ֥זֶר הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ עַל־הַמִּצְנָֽפֶת׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will put the turban on his head and put the crown of holiness on the turban.

en.L: And you shall set the turban on his head, and you shall put the crown of holiness on the turban.
en.B: Place the turban on his head and fasten the holy crown to the turban.
en.R: Put the turban on his head. Then attach the holy crown, the gold plate, to the turban.

es.L: Y pondrás el turbante sobre su cabeza, y pondrás la diadema de santidad sobre el turbante.
es.B: Colócale el turbante en la cabeza y sujeta la diadema santa al turbante.
es.R: Ponle el turbante en la cabeza. Después fija en el turbante la diadema santa, la lámina de oro.

fr.L: Et tu placeras le turban sur sa tête, et tu mettras le diadème de sainteté sur le turban.
fr.B: Place le turban sur sa tête et fixe le diadème sacré sur le turban.
fr.R: Mets le turban sur sa tête. Puis attache au turban le diadème sacré, la lame d’or.

sw.L: Nawe utaweka kilemba juu ya kichwa chake, na kuweka taji ya utakatifu juu ya kilemba.
sw.B: Mvike kilemba kichwani, na uifunge taji takatifu kwenye kilemba.
sw.R: Mvike kilemba kichwani. Kisha funga kwenye kilemba ile taji takatifu, yaani bamba la dhahabu.

decisions.choice: the crown of holiness: the gold plate on the front of the turban
decisions.reason: The word means a crown or a sign of dedication. Here it is the plate of pure gold engraved "Holy to Yahweh" that was tied to the front of the turban (28:36-37); 39:30 calls it "the plate of the holy crown".

decisions.choice: the gold plate
decisions.reason: Readable says what the holy crown was, from 28:36 and 39:30.

decisions.choice: "la diadema"
decisions.reason: The "crown" is a gold plate tied to the front of the turban (28:36-37). "Diadema" fits it better than "corona", which suggests a king's crown.

decisions.choice: "le diadème"
decisions.reason: The "crown" is a gold plate tied to the front of the turban (28:36-37). French "diadème", a band or ornament worn on the head, fits it better than "couronne", which suggests a king's crown.

source.text: וְלָֽקַחְתָּ֙ אֶת־שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וְיָצַקְתָּ֖ עַל־רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֖ אֹתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will take the oil of the anointing and pour [it] on his head and anoint him.

en.L: And you shall take the oil of anointing and pour [it] on his head and anoint him.
en.B: Then take the anointing oil and pour it over his head. In this way you will anoint him.
en.R: Then take the anointing oil and pour some on his head to anoint him.

es.L: Y tomarás el aceite de la unción, y [lo] derramarás sobre su cabeza, y lo ungirás.
es.B: Después toma el aceite de la unción y derrámalo sobre su cabeza. Así lo ungirás.
es.R: Luego toma el aceite de la unción y échale un poco en la cabeza para ungirlo.

fr.L: Et tu prendras l’huile d’onction, et tu [la] verseras sur sa tête, et tu l’oindras.
fr.B: Ensuite, prends l’huile d’onction et verse-la sur sa tête. C’est ainsi que tu l’oindras.
fr.R: Ensuite, prends l’huile d’onction et verses-en un peu sur sa tête pour l’oindre.

sw.L: Nawe utachukua mafuta ya kupaka, na [kuyamimina] juu ya kichwa chake, na kumpaka mafuta.
sw.B: Kisha chukua mafuta ya kupaka uyamimine juu ya kichwa chake. Ndivyo utakavyompaka mafuta.
sw.R: Kisha chukua mafuta ya kupaka, umimine kiasi kichwani pake ili kumpaka mafuta.

decisions.choice: anoint: mark him as set apart for God's service
decisions.reason: Pouring the holy oil on Aaron's head marks him as consecrated to God (30:30; Leviticus 8:12; Psalm 133:2). In Israel kings and priests were anointed for their office.

decisions.choice: the anointing oil: the holy oil made by God's own recipe
decisions.reason: The oil is olive oil blended with spices, made as 30:22-33 describes and used for nothing else.

decisions.choice: "kumpaka mafuta"
decisions.reason: Swahili has no single verb for "anoint"; "kumpaka mafuta", to put oil on him, matches "mafuta ya kupaka", the anointing oil of 25:6.

source.text: וְאֶת־בָּנָ֖יו תַּקְרִ֑יב וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֖ם כֻּתֳּנֹֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: And his sons you will bring near and clothe them [with] tunics,

en.L: And his sons you shall bring near and clothe them [with] tunics,
en.B: Then bring his sons forward and dress them in tunics,
en.R: Next bring Aaron's sons and put tunics on them.

es.L: Y a sus hijos los harás acercarse, y los vestirás [con] túnicas,
es.B: Luego haz que se acerquen sus hijos y vístelos con túnicas,
es.R: Después trae a los hijos de Aarón y ponles túnicas.

fr.L: Et ses fils, tu les feras approcher, et tu les revêtiras de tuniques,
fr.B: Fais ensuite avancer ses fils et revêts-les de tuniques,
fr.R: Ensuite, fais venir les fils d’Aaron et mets-leur des tuniques.

sw.L: Na wanawe utawasogeza karibu, na kuwavika kanzu,
sw.B: Kisha walete wanawe mbele uwavike kanzu,
sw.R: Kisha walete wana wa Haruni uwavike kanzu.

decisions.choice: tunics: the plainer garments of the ordinary priests
decisions.reason: Aaron's sons wear tunics, sashes and caps (28:40), not the ephod, breastpiece and robe that belong to Aaron alone as the chief priest.

decisions.choice: Aaron's sons
decisions.reason: Readable names Aaron for "his" and ends the sentence here; Literal and Balanced run on into verse 9.

source.text: וְחָגַרְתָּ֩ אֹתָ֨ם אַבְנֵ֜ט אַהֲרֹ֣ן וּבָנָ֗יו וְחָבַשְׁתָּ֤ לָהֶם֙ מִגְבָּעֹ֔ת וְהָיְתָ֥ה לָהֶ֛ם כְּהֻנָּ֖ה לְחֻקַּ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם וּמִלֵּאתָ֥ יַֽד־אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְיַד־בָּנָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: and you will gird them [with] a sash, Aaron and his sons, and bind on them caps, and will be to them [the] priesthood as a statute of perpetuity. And you will fill [the] hand of Aaron and [the] hand of his sons.

en.L: and you shall gird them [with] a sash, Aaron and his sons, and you shall bind caps on them; and the priesthood shall belong to them as a statute forever. And you shall fill the hand of Aaron and the hand of his sons.
en.B: and tie sashes around them, both Aaron and his sons, and fit caps on their heads. The priesthood will belong to them by a statute for all time. And you will ordain Aaron and his sons.
en.R: Tie sashes around the waists of Aaron and his sons, and put caps on the sons' heads. The priesthood will belong to them and their descendants for all time. This is a rule that will not change. In this way you will ordain Aaron and his sons as priests.

es.L: y los ceñirás con fajas, a Aarón y a sus hijos, y les atarás gorros; y el sacerdocio será de ellos como estatuto perpetuo. Y llenarás la mano de Aarón y la mano de sus hijos.
es.B: y ata las fajas a Aarón y a sus hijos, y ponles los gorros en la cabeza. El sacerdocio les pertenecerá por un estatuto perpetuo. Y así investirás a Aarón y a sus hijos.
es.R: Ata fajas a la cintura de Aarón y de sus hijos, y pon gorros en la cabeza de los hijos. El sacerdocio será de ellos y de sus descendientes para siempre. Es una norma que no cambiará. Así investirás a Aarón y a sus hijos como sacerdotes.

fr.L: et tu les ceindras d’une ceinture, Aaron et ses fils, et tu leur attacheras des bonnets ; et le sacerdoce sera à eux comme une loi perpétuelle. Et tu rempliras la main d’Aaron et la main de ses fils.
fr.B: et noue-leur des ceintures, à Aaron et à ses fils, et ajuste des bonnets sur leur tête. Le sacerdoce leur appartiendra selon une loi perpétuelle. Et tu investiras Aaron et ses fils.
fr.R: Noue des ceintures autour de la taille d’Aaron et de ses fils, et mets des bonnets sur la tête des fils. Le sacerdoce leur appartiendra, à eux et à leurs descendants, pour toujours. C’est une règle qui ne changera pas. Ainsi, tu investiras Aaron et ses fils comme prêtres.

sw.L: na kuwafunga mishipi, Haruni na wanawe, na kuwafungia kofia; na ukuhani utakuwa wao kwa kanuni ya kudumu milele. Nawe utaujaza mkono wa Haruni na mkono wa wanawe.
sw.B: na uwafunge mishipi, Haruni na wanawe, na uwavike kofia vichwani. Ukuhani utakuwa wao kwa kanuni ya kudumu milele. Hivyo utawasimika Haruni na wanawe.
sw.R: Wafunge Haruni na wanawe mishipi viunoni, na uwavike wanawe kofia vichwani. Ukuhani utakuwa wao na wa wazao wao milele. Hii ni kanuni isiyobadilika. Hivyo ndivyo utakavyowasimika Haruni na wanawe kuwa makuhani.

decisions.choice: fill the hand: ordain, install in the priest's office
decisions.reason: "Fill the hand" is the Hebrew way of saying that someone is installed in an office, especially as priest (28:41; Judges 17:5, 12; 1 Kings 13:33). Where the idiom comes from is not certain: it may come from placing the offerings in the priests' hands (verse 24), or from giving them their authority or their share. The ram of verse 22 is named for it, "the ram of filling", and the whole seven-day rite is the filling of their hands (verse 35).

decisions.choice: a statute forever: a fixed rule for all time
decisions.reason: "Statute" is a fixed rule; "forever" means for all generations to come. The priesthood belongs to Aaron's family for as long as Israel continues (40:15; Numbers 25:13).

decisions.choice: bind caps on them: on Aaron's sons
decisions.reason: "Them" most likely means the sons, who wear caps (28:40), while Aaron wears the turban (verse 6). It may also include Aaron with the sons, as the sash does.

decisions.choice: ordain
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the idiom "fill the hand". Balanced and Readable say what it means, "ordain".

decisions.choice: and their descendants ... This is a rule that will not change
decisions.reason: Readable says that "forever" includes the generations after them, and explains "statute" in a sentence of its own.

decisions.choice: "investirás"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the idiom "llenar la mano". Balanced and Readable say "investir", to install in an office; "ordenar" would be read as "command", and "consagrar" is kept for "make holy" (verse 1). The noun is "la investidura" (verses 22-35).

decisions.choice: "tu investiras"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the idiom "remplir la main". Balanced and Readable say "investir", to install in an office, keeping "consacrer" for the separate verb "make holy" (verse 1). The noun is "l'investiture" (verses 22-35).

decisions.choice: "utawasimika"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the idiom "kujaza mkono". Balanced and Readable say "kuwasimika", to install in an office, the usual word for installing a leader; "kutakasa" is kept for "make holy" (verse 1).

source.text: וְהִקְרַבְתָּ֙ אֶת־הַפָּ֔ר לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְסָמַ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הַפָּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will bring near the young bull before the tent of meeting, and will lay Aaron and his sons their hands on [the] head of the bull.

en.L: And you shall bring the bull near before the tent of meeting, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the bull.
en.B: Lead the bull to the front of the tent of meeting, where Aaron and his sons are to place their hands on its head.
en.R: Bring the bull to the front of the tent of meeting. Aaron and his sons must put their hands on the bull's head.

es.L: Y harás acercar el novillo delante de la Tienda del Encuentro, y Aarón y sus hijos apoyarán sus manos sobre la cabeza del novillo.
es.B: Lleva el novillo ante la Tienda del Encuentro, donde Aarón y sus hijos pondrán las manos sobre su cabeza.
es.R: Lleva el novillo frente a la Tienda del Encuentro. Aarón y sus hijos deben poner las manos sobre la cabeza del novillo.

fr.L: Et tu feras approcher le taureau devant la tente de la Rencontre, et Aaron et ses fils appuieront leurs mains sur la tête du taureau.
fr.B: Amène le taureau devant la tente de la Rencontre ; là, Aaron et ses fils poseront les mains sur sa tête.
fr.R: Amène le taureau devant la tente de la Rencontre. Aaron et ses fils doivent mettre leurs mains sur la tête du taureau.

sw.L: Nawe utamsogeza fahali mbele ya Hema la Kukutania, na Haruni na wanawe wataegemeza mikono yao juu ya kichwa cha fahali.
sw.B: Mlete fahali mbele ya Hema la Kukutania, na hapo Haruni na wanawe wataweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.
sw.R: Mlete fahali mbele ya Hema la Kukutania. Haruni na wanawe lazima waweke mikono yao juu ya kichwa cha fahali.

decisions.choice: lay their hands on: press their hands on the animal's head
decisions.reason: The verb means to lean or press. By pressing their hands on the head, the offerers mark the animal as their own offering, given in their place (Leviticus 1:4; 4:4; 16:21). Here Aaron and his sons are the offerers, so the offering is for them.

source.text: וְשָׁחַטְתָּ֥ אֶת־הַפָּ֖ר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will slaughter the young bull before Yahweh, [at the] entrance of the tent of meeting.

en.L: And you shall slaughter the bull before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, [at] the entrance of the tent of meeting.
en.B: Slaughter the bull there before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, at the doorway of the tent of meeting.
en.R: Then kill the bull there at the door of the tent of meeting, in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y degollarás el novillo delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, [a] la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro.
es.B: Degüella allí el novillo delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro.
es.R: Luego mata el novillo allí, a la entrada de la Tienda del Encuentro, delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et tu égorgeras le taureau devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, [à] l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre.
fr.B: Égorge le taureau à cet endroit, devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre.
fr.R: Puis tue le taureau là, à l’entrée de la tente de la Rencontre, devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nawe utamchinja fahali mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, [penye] mlango wa Hema la Kukutania.
sw.B: Mchinje fahali hapo mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania.
sw.R: Kisha mchinje fahali hapo kwenye mlango wa Hema la Kukutania, mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: before Yahweh: in his presence, at his dwelling
decisions.reason: The tent is God's dwelling (25:8), so what is done at its entrance is done in his presence.

decisions.choice: you will slaughter: Moses acts as priest at the ordination
decisions.reason: Until Aaron and his sons are ordained, Moses carries out the priestly acts himself, as Leviticus 8:14-30 tells.

source.text: וְלָֽקַחְתָּ֙ מִדַּ֣ם הַפָּ֔ר וְנָתַתָּ֛ה עַל־קַרְנֹ֥ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ בְּאֶצְבָּעֶ֑ךָ וְאֶת־כָּל־הַדָּ֣ם תִּשְׁפֹּ֔ךְ אֶל־יְס֖וֹד הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will take some of [the] blood of the bull and put [it] on [the] horns of the altar with your finger, and all the blood you will pour out at [the] base of the altar.

en.L: And you shall take some of the blood of the bull and put [it] on the horns of the altar with your finger, and all the blood you shall pour out at the base of the altar.
en.B: With your finger, smear some of the bull's blood on the horns of the altar, and pour out all the rest beside the altar's base.
en.R: Use your finger to put some of the bull's blood on the corners of the altar that stick up like horns. Then pour out the rest of the blood at the bottom of the altar.

es.L: Y tomarás de la sangre del novillo, y [la] pondrás sobre los cuernos del altar con tu dedo, y toda la sangre la derramarás al pie del altar.
es.B: Con tu dedo, unta un poco de la sangre del novillo en los cuernos del altar, y derrama todo el resto al pie del altar.
es.R: Con el dedo, pon un poco de la sangre del novillo en las esquinas del altar que sobresalen como cuernos. Después echa el resto de la sangre en la parte de abajo del altar.

fr.L: Et tu prendras du sang du taureau, et tu [le] mettras sur les cornes de l’autel avec ton doigt, et tout le sang, tu le répandras au pied de l’autel.
fr.B: Avec ton doigt, enduis de sang du taureau les cornes de l’autel, et répands tout le reste au pied de l’autel.
fr.R: Avec ton doigt, mets un peu du sang du taureau sur les coins de l’autel qui se dressent comme des cornes. Ensuite, verse le reste du sang en bas de l’autel.

sw.L: Nawe utachukua sehemu ya damu ya fahali, na [kuitia] juu ya pembe za madhabahu kwa kidole chako, na damu yote utaimwaga chini ya madhabahu.
sw.B: Kwa kidole chako, paka sehemu ya damu ya fahali kwenye pembe za madhabahu, na damu yote iliyobaki uimwage chini ya madhabahu.
sw.R: Tumia kidole chako kutia sehemu ya damu ya fahali kwenye pembe za madhabahu, yaani zile ncha zilizochomoza juu kwenye kona zake. Kisha mwaga damu iliyobaki chini ya madhabahu.

decisions.choice: the horns of the altar: the raised corners of the bronze altar
decisions.reason: The altar of burnt offering had a horn at each of its four corners, made in one piece with it (27:1-2). Blood on the horns marks the altar as cleansed (verse 36; Leviticus 4:7; 8:15).

decisions.choice: all the blood: all the blood that is left
decisions.reason: Some of the blood has already been put on the horns; "all the blood" is the rest of it.

decisions.choice: corners ... that stick up like horns
decisions.reason: Readable explains what the horns of the altar were.

source.text: וְלָֽקַחְתָּ֗ אֶֽת־כָּל־הַחֵלֶב֮ הַֽמְכַסֶּ֣ה אֶת־הַקֶּרֶב֒ וְאֵ֗ת הַיֹּתֶ֨רֶת֙ עַל־הַכָּבֵ֔ד וְאֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֔ת וְאֶת־הַחֵ֖לֶב אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֑ן וְהִקְטַרְתָּ֖ הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will take all the fat [which] covers the entrails and the lobe on the liver and the two kidneys and the fat which [is] on them and make [them] smoke on the altar.

en.L: And you shall take all the fat that covers the entrails, and the lobe on the liver, and the two kidneys, and the fat that [is] on them, and make [them] smoke on the altar.
en.B: Remove all the fat that covers the inner parts, the lobe that sits on the liver, and the two kidneys together with their fat, and turn them into smoke on the altar.
en.R: Cut out all the fat around the bull's insides, the piece that covers the liver, and the two kidneys with their fat. Burn them on the altar.

es.L: Y tomarás toda la grasa que cubre las entrañas, y el lóbulo sobre el hígado, y los dos riñones, y la grasa que [está] sobre ellos, y [los] harás humear sobre el altar.
es.B: Quita toda la grasa que cubre las vísceras, el lóbulo que está sobre el hígado y los dos riñones con su grasa, y hazlos subir en humo sobre el altar.
es.R: Saca toda la grasa que rodea los órganos internos del novillo, el trozo que cubre el hígado y los dos riñones con su grasa. Quémalos en el altar.

fr.L: Et tu prendras toute la graisse qui couvre les entrailles, et le lobe [qui est] sur le foie, et les deux rognons, et la graisse qui [est] sur eux, et tu [les] feras fumer sur l’autel.
fr.B: Retire toute la graisse qui enveloppe les viscères, le lobe qui se trouve sur le foie, ainsi que les deux rognons avec leur graisse, et fais-les monter en fumée sur l’autel.
fr.R: Enlève toute la graisse qui entoure les organes du ventre du taureau, le morceau qui couvre le foie, et les deux rognons avec leur graisse. Brûle-les sur l’autel.

sw.L: Nawe utachukua shahamu yote inayofunika matumbo, na kipande kilicho juu ya ini, na figo mbili, na shahamu iliyo juu yake, na [kuvi]fukiza juu ya madhabahu.
sw.B: Ondoa shahamu yote inayofunika viungo vya ndani, kipande kilicho juu ya ini, na figo mbili pamoja na shahamu yake, uvifukize juu ya madhabahu.
sw.R: Kata shahamu yote inayozunguka viungo vya ndani vya fahali, kipande kinachofunika ini, na figo mbili pamoja na shahamu yake. Vichome juu ya madhabahu.

decisions.choice: the fat: the choicest parts, which belong to God
decisions.reason: The fat around the inner organs was counted the best part of the animal, and it always went to God on the altar (Leviticus 3:3-5, 16-17).

decisions.choice: the lobe on the liver: a piece of the liver, or the fatty covering over it
decisions.reason: The word means what is left over or what projects. It names a part of or over the liver, perhaps its long lobe or the fatty membrane that covers it. Which part is meant is not certain.

decisions.choice: make smoke: burn so that it goes up as smoke
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for burning incense and offerings. It pictures the offering rising to God as smoke (verse 18).

source.text: וְאֶת־בְּשַׂ֤ר הַפָּר֙ וְאֶת־עֹר֣וֹ וְאֶת־פִּרְשׁ֔וֹ תִּשְׂרֹ֣ף בָּאֵ֔שׁ מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה חַטָּ֖את הֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: And the flesh of the bull and its hide and its dung you will burn with fire outside of the camp; a sin offering it [is].

en.L: And the flesh of the bull and its hide and its dung you shall burn with fire outside the camp; it [is] a sin offering.
en.B: As for the bull's meat, its hide and its dung, burn them in a fire outside the camp. It is a sin offering.
en.R: But burn the rest of the bull, its meat, its skin and its dung, outside the camp. It is a sin offering, an offering to take away sin.

es.L: Y la carne del novillo y su piel y su estiércol los quemarás al fuego fuera del campamento; [es] un sacrificio por el pecado.
es.B: En cuanto a la carne del novillo, su piel y su estiércol, quémalos en el fuego fuera del campamento. Es un sacrificio por el pecado.
es.R: Pero quema fuera del campamento el resto del novillo: su carne, su piel y su estiércol. Es un sacrificio por el pecado, una ofrenda para quitar el pecado.

fr.L: Et la chair du taureau, et sa peau, et ses excréments, tu les brûleras au feu hors du camp ; c’[est] un sacrifice pour le péché.
fr.B: Quant à la viande du taureau, à sa peau et à ses excréments, brûle-les au feu hors du camp. C’est un sacrifice pour le péché.
fr.R: Mais brûle hors du camp le reste du taureau : sa viande, sa peau et ses excréments. C’est un sacrifice pour le péché, une offrande pour enlever le péché.

sw.L: Na nyama ya fahali na ngozi yake na mavi yake utaviteketeza kwa moto nje ya kambi; ni sadaka ya dhambi.
sw.B: Nyama ya fahali, ngozi yake na mavi yake, uviteketeze kwa moto nje ya kambi. Ni sadaka ya dhambi.
sw.R: Lakini choma nje ya kambi sehemu iliyobaki ya fahali: nyama yake, ngozi yake na mavi yake. Ni sadaka ya dhambi, sadaka ya kuondoa dhambi.

decisions.choice: sin offering: an offering that cleanses from sin
decisions.reason: The noun is the ordinary word for sin, used for the offering that deals with it. Its blood cleanses the altar and the people from the defilement of sin (verse 36; Leviticus 4; 16:16). For that reason it is also understood as a "purification offering".

decisions.choice: outside the camp: the meat is not eaten
decisions.reason: When a sin offering is made for the priests themselves, its meat is not eaten by them but burned outside the camp (Leviticus 4:11-12; 8:17). Hebrews 13:11-12 recalls this rule.

decisions.choice: an offering to take away sin
decisions.reason: Readable keeps "sin offering" and adds a short explanation of its purpose.

source.text: וְאֶת־הָאַ֥יִל הָאֶחָ֖ד תִּקָּ֑ח וְסָ֨מְכ֜וּ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הָאָֽיִל׃

records.literal_gloss: And the ram, the one, you will take, and will lay Aaron and his sons their hands on [the] head of the ram.

en.L: And the one ram you shall take, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.
en.B: Next take the first ram. Aaron and his sons are to rest their hands on the ram's head.
en.R: Then take one of the rams. Aaron and his sons must put their hands on its head.

es.L: Y tomarás uno de los carneros, y Aarón y sus hijos apoyarán sus manos sobre la cabeza del carnero.
es.B: Luego toma el primer carnero. Aarón y sus hijos pondrán las manos sobre su cabeza.
es.R: Después toma uno de los carneros. Aarón y sus hijos deben poner las manos sobre su cabeza.

fr.L: Et l’un des béliers, tu le prendras, et Aaron et ses fils appuieront leurs mains sur la tête du bélier.
fr.B: Prends ensuite le premier bélier. Aaron et ses fils poseront les mains sur sa tête.
fr.R: Ensuite, prends l’un des béliers. Aaron et ses fils doivent mettre leurs mains sur sa tête.

sw.L: Nawe utamchukua kondoo dume mmoja, na Haruni na wanawe wataegemeza mikono yao juu ya kichwa cha kondoo dume.
sw.B: Kisha mchukue kondoo dume wa kwanza. Haruni na wanawe wataweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.
sw.R: Kisha chukua mmoja wa kondoo dume. Haruni na wanawe lazima waweke mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.

decisions.choice: the one ram: the first of the two rams
decisions.reason: Verse 1 called for two rams. This is the first; verse 19 turns to "the second ram".

decisions.choice: lay their hands: as with the bull
decisions.reason: The rite is the same as in verse 10: the priests mark the ram as their own offering.

source.text: וְשָׁחַטְתָּ֖ אֶת־הָאָ֑יִל וְלָֽקַחְתָּ֙ אֶת־דָּמ֔וֹ וְזָרַקְתָּ֥ עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will slaughter the ram and take its blood and splash [it] on the altar all around.

en.L: And you shall slaughter the ram, and you shall take its blood and dash [it] against the altar all around.
en.B: Kill the ram, collect its blood, and throw it against the altar on all sides.
en.R: Kill the ram. Take its blood and splash it all around the altar.

es.L: Y degollarás el carnero, y tomarás su sangre, y [la] arrojarás contra el altar, alrededor.
es.B: Degüella el carnero, recoge su sangre y salpícala por todos los lados del altar.
es.R: Mata el carnero. Toma su sangre y salpícala alrededor del altar.

fr.L: Et tu égorgeras le bélier, et tu prendras son sang, et tu [le] jetteras contre l’autel, tout autour.
fr.B: Égorge le bélier, recueille son sang et projette-le sur tous les côtés de l’autel.
fr.R: Tue le bélier. Prends son sang et projette-le tout autour de l’autel.

sw.L: Nawe utamchinja kondoo dume, na kuichukua damu yake, na kuirusha kwenye madhabahu pande zote.
sw.B: Mchinje kondoo dume, uikusanye damu yake na kuirusha kwenye madhabahu pande zote.
sw.R: Mchinje kondoo dume. Chukua damu yake uirushe pande zote za madhabahu.

decisions.choice: splash: throw or dash the blood in quantity
decisions.reason: The verb means to toss or throw, as from a bowl, not to sprinkle drops (Leviticus 1:5, 11). A different verb, "spatter", is used in verse 21.

source.text: וְאֶ֨ת־הָאַ֔יִל תְּנַתֵּ֖חַ לִנְתָחָ֑יו וְרָחַצְתָּ֤ קִרְבּוֹ֙ וּכְרָעָ֔יו וְנָתַתָּ֥ עַל־נְתָחָ֖יו וְעַל־רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And the ram you will cut into its pieces and wash its entrails and its legs and put [them] with its pieces and with its head.

en.L: And the ram you shall cut into its pieces, and you shall wash its entrails and its legs, and put [them] with its pieces and with its head.
en.B: Divide the ram into its pieces. Wash its insides and its legs, and set them beside its pieces and its head.
en.R: Cut up the ram. Wash the inside parts and the legs, then put them together with the head and all the other pieces.

es.L: Y el carnero lo cortarás en sus piezas, y lavarás sus entrañas y sus patas, y [las] pondrás con sus piezas y con su cabeza.
es.B: Divide el carnero en piezas. Lava sus vísceras y sus patas, y colócalas junto a las piezas y la cabeza.
es.R: Corta el carnero en pedazos. Lava los órganos internos y las patas, y ponlos junto con la cabeza y todos los demás pedazos.

fr.L: Et le bélier, tu le couperas en ses morceaux, et tu laveras ses entrailles et ses pattes, et tu [les] mettras avec ses morceaux et avec sa tête.
fr.B: Découpe le bélier en morceaux. Lave ses viscères et ses pattes, et place-les à côté des morceaux et de la tête.
fr.R: Découpe le bélier. Lave les organes du ventre et les pattes, puis mets-les avec la tête et tous les autres morceaux.

sw.L: Nawe utamkata kondoo dume vipande vyake, na kuosha matumbo yake na miguu yake, na [kuviweka] pamoja na vipande vyake na kichwa chake.
sw.B: Mkate kondoo dume vipande vipande. Osha viungo vyake vya ndani na miguu yake, uviweke pamoja na vipande vyake na kichwa chake.
sw.R: Mkate kondoo dume vipande. Osha viungo vya ndani na miguu, kisha uviweke pamoja na kichwa na vipande vingine vyote.

decisions.choice: wash its entrails and legs: clean the parts that would be soiled
decisions.reason: The inner parts and the legs were washed of dung and dirt before they were laid on the altar (Leviticus 1:9).

decisions.choice: with its pieces: on top of or beside them
decisions.reason: The preposition can mean "on" or "along with". Either way the washed parts are laid with the rest of the ram, so that the whole animal is burned (verse 18).

source.text: וְהִקְטַרְתָּ֤ אֶת־כָּל־הָאַ֨יִל֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עֹלָ֥ה ה֖וּא לַֽיהוָ֑ה רֵ֣יחַ נִיח֔וֹחַ אִשֶּׁ֥ה לַיהוָ֖ה הֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will make smoke all the ram on the altar; a burnt offering it [is] to Yahweh, an aroma of soothing, an offering by fire to Yahweh it [is].

en.L: And you shall make the whole ram smoke on the altar. It [is] a burnt offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, an aroma of soothing; it [is] an offering by fire to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Send up the whole ram in smoke from the altar as a burnt offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. It is an offering by fire to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, with an aroma that pleases {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: Burn the whole ram on the altar. It is a burnt offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. It is an offering burned with fire for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and its smell pleases {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Y harás humear todo el carnero sobre el altar. [Es] un holocausto {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, aroma grato; [es] una ofrenda quemada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Haz subir en humo todo el carnero sobre el altar como holocausto {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Es una ofrenda quemada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, de aroma grato para {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Quema todo el carnero en el altar. Es un holocausto {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Es una ofrenda quemada en el fuego para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y su olor {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} agrada.

fr.L: Et tu feras fumer tout le bélier sur l’autel. C’[est] un holocauste pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, une odeur apaisante ; c’[est] une offrande consumée par le feu pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Fais monter en fumée tout le bélier sur l’autel : c’est un holocauste pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. C’est une offrande consumée par le feu pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, une odeur apaisante qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} plaît.
fr.R: Brûle tout le bélier sur l’autel. C’est un holocauste pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. C’est une offrande brûlée sur le feu pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et son odeur {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} plaît.

sw.L: Nawe utamfukiza kondoo dume mzima juu ya madhabahu. Ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, harufu ya kupendeza; ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Mfukize kondoo dume mzima juu ya madhabahu kama sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, yenye harufu inayompendeza.
sw.R: Mchome kondoo dume mzima juu ya madhabahu. Ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Ni sadaka iliyochomwa kwa moto kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na harufu yake inampendeza.

decisions.choice: burnt offering: an offering burned whole on the altar
decisions.reason: The word means "what goes up". Nothing of the animal is eaten; all of it goes up to God in smoke (Leviticus 1).

decisions.choice: an aroma of soothing: a pleasing aroma, an offering God accepts
decisions.reason: The phrase first appears in Genesis 8:21, after the flood. It says that God receives the offering with favor; it does not mean that God needs food.

decisions.choice: offering by fire: an offering given to God on the altar fire
decisions.reason: The word is usually linked with the word for fire, since these offerings are burned. It may instead mean a gift, since it is also used of parts that are not burned (Leviticus 24:7, 9).

decisions.choice: with an aroma that pleases him / its smell pleases him
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "an aroma of soothing". Balanced and Readable say what it means.

source.text: וְלָ֣קַחְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת הָאַ֣יִל הַשֵּׁנִ֑י וְסָמַ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת־יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־רֹ֥אשׁ הָאָֽיִל׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will take the ram, the second, and will lay Aaron and his sons their hands on [the] head of the ram.

en.L: And you shall take the second ram, and Aaron and his sons shall lay their hands on the head of the ram.
en.B: Then take the other ram, and Aaron and his sons are to rest their hands on its head.
en.R: Then take the second ram. Aaron and his sons must put their hands on its head.

es.L: Y tomarás el segundo carnero, y Aarón y sus hijos apoyarán sus manos sobre la cabeza del carnero.
es.B: Después toma el otro carnero, y Aarón y sus hijos pondrán las manos sobre su cabeza.
es.R: Luego toma el segundo carnero. Aarón y sus hijos deben poner las manos sobre su cabeza.

fr.L: Et tu prendras le second bélier, et Aaron et ses fils appuieront leurs mains sur la tête du bélier.
fr.B: Prends ensuite l’autre bélier, et Aaron et ses fils poseront les mains sur sa tête.
fr.R: Ensuite, prends le deuxième bélier. Aaron et ses fils doivent mettre leurs mains sur sa tête.

sw.L: Nawe utamchukua kondoo dume wa pili, na Haruni na wanawe wataegemeza mikono yao juu ya kichwa cha kondoo dume.
sw.B: Kisha mchukue kondoo dume yule mwingine, na Haruni na wanawe wataweka mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.
sw.R: Kisha chukua kondoo dume wa pili. Haruni na wanawe lazima waweke mikono yao juu ya kichwa chake.

decisions.choice: the second ram: the ram of ordination
decisions.reason: Verse 22 names this ram "the ram of ordination". Its blood and its parts are used in the rites that install the priests (verses 20-28).

source.text: וְשָׁחַטְתָּ֣ אֶת־הָאַ֗יִל וְלָקַחְתָּ֤ מִדָּמוֹ֙ וְנָֽתַתָּ֡ה עַל־תְּנוּךְ֩ אֹ֨זֶן אַהֲרֹ֜ן וְעַל־תְּנ֨וּךְ אֹ֤זֶן בָּנָיו֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־בֹּ֤הֶן יָדָם֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְלָ֖ם הַיְמָנִ֑ית וְזָרַקְתָּ֧ אֶת־הַדָּ֛ם עַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will slaughter the ram and take some of its blood and put [it] on [the] lobe of [the] ear of Aaron and on [the] lobe of [the] ear of his sons, the right, and on [the] thumb of their hand, the right, and on [the] big toe of their foot, the right, and splash the blood on the altar all around.

en.L: And you shall slaughter the ram, and take some of its blood and put [it] on the lobe of Aaron's [right] ear and on the lobe of his sons' right ear, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the big toe of their right foot; and you shall dash the blood against the altar all around.
en.B: Kill this ram and take some of its blood. Put the blood on Aaron's right earlobe and on the right earlobes of his sons, on the thumbs of their right hands and the big toes of their right feet. Throw the rest of the blood against the altar all around.
en.R: Kill the ram and take some of its blood. Put some on the bottom of the right ear of Aaron and of each of his sons. Put some on the thumb of their right hands and on the big toe of their right feet. Then splash the rest of the blood all around the altar.

es.L: Y degollarás el carnero, y tomarás de su sangre, y [la] pondrás sobre el lóbulo de la oreja [derecha] de Aarón y sobre el lóbulo de la oreja derecha de sus hijos, y sobre el pulgar de su mano derecha, y sobre el dedo gordo de su pie derecho; y arrojarás la sangre contra el altar, alrededor.
es.B: Degüella este carnero y toma un poco de su sangre. Ponla en el lóbulo de la oreja derecha de Aarón y en el lóbulo de la oreja derecha de sus hijos, en el pulgar de su mano derecha y en el dedo gordo de su pie derecho. Salpica el resto de la sangre por todos los lados del altar.
es.R: Mata el carnero y toma un poco de su sangre. Pon un poco en la parte de abajo de la oreja derecha de Aarón y de cada uno de sus hijos. Pon también un poco en el pulgar de su mano derecha y en el dedo gordo de su pie derecho. Después salpica el resto de la sangre alrededor del altar.

fr.L: Et tu égorgeras le bélier, et tu prendras de son sang, et tu [le] mettras sur le lobe de l’oreille [droite] d’Aaron, et sur le lobe de l’oreille droite de ses fils, et sur le pouce de leur main droite, et sur le gros orteil de leur pied droit ; et tu jetteras le sang contre l’autel, tout autour.
fr.B: Égorge ce bélier et prends un peu de son sang. Mets-en sur le lobe de l’oreille droite d’Aaron et sur le lobe de l’oreille droite de ses fils, sur le pouce de leur main droite et sur le gros orteil de leur pied droit. Projette le reste du sang sur tous les côtés de l’autel.
fr.R: Tue le bélier et prends un peu de son sang. Mets-en sur le bas de l’oreille droite d’Aaron et de chacun de ses fils. Mets-en aussi sur le pouce de leur main droite et sur le gros orteil de leur pied droit. Ensuite, projette le reste du sang tout autour de l’autel.

sw.L: Nawe utamchinja kondoo dume, na kuchukua sehemu ya damu yake, na [kuitia] juu ya ndewe ya sikio [la kulia] la Haruni, na juu ya ndewe ya sikio la kulia la wanawe, na juu ya kidole gumba cha mkono wao wa kulia, na juu ya kidole gumba cha mguu wao wa kulia; na kuirusha damu kwenye madhabahu pande zote.
sw.B: Mchinje kondoo dume huyo uchukue sehemu ya damu yake. Itie kwenye ndewe ya sikio la kulia la Haruni na kwenye ndewe za masikio ya kulia ya wanawe, kwenye vidole gumba vya mikono yao ya kulia na kwenye vidole gumba vya miguu yao ya kulia. Damu iliyobaki uirushe kwenye madhabahu pande zote.
sw.R: Mchinje kondoo dume na uchukue sehemu ya damu yake. Tia kidogo chini ya sikio la kulia la Haruni na la kila mmoja wa wanawe. Tia kidogo pia kwenye kidole gumba cha mkono wao wa kulia na kwenye kidole kikubwa cha mguu wao wa kulia. Kisha rusha damu iliyobaki pande zote za madhabahu.

decisions.choice: ear, thumb and big toe: the whole person marked for God's service
decisions.reason: The text does not explain the sign. The same three places are marked when a person healed of a skin disease is cleansed (Leviticus 14:14, 17). Touching the ear, the hand and the foot, from the head to the feet, may mark the whole person as consecrated: what he hears, what he does, and where he goes.

decisions.choice: put on: carried out in Leviticus 8:23-24
decisions.reason: Leviticus 8 tells how Moses did all that this chapter commands, including this rite.

decisions.choice: the rest of the blood
decisions.reason: Some of the blood has been used on the priests; what is thrown against the altar is the rest of it.

decisions.choice: "ndewe ya sikio"; "kidole gumba cha mguu"
decisions.reason: "Ndewe" is the soft lobe at the bottom of the ear; "kidole gumba" is used for both the thumb and the big toe, with "cha mguu" for the toe. Readable says "chini ya sikio" and "kidole kikubwa cha mguu".

source.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ֞ מִן־הַדָּ֨ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַֽל־הַמִּזְבֵּחַ֮ וּמִשֶּׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָה֒ וְהִזֵּיתָ֤ עַֽל־אַהֲרֹן֙ וְעַל־בְּגָדָ֔יו וְעַל־בָּנָ֛יו וְעַל־בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו אִתּ֑וֹ וְקָדַ֥שׁ הוּא֙ וּבְגָדָ֔יו וּבָנָ֛יו וּבִגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו אִתּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will take some of the blood which [is] on the altar and some of the oil of the anointing and spatter [it] on Aaron and on his garments and on his sons and on the garments of his sons with him; and he will be holy, and his garments, and his sons and the garments of his sons with him.

en.L: And you shall take some of the blood that [is] on the altar and some of the anointing oil and spatter [it] on Aaron and on his garments, and on his sons and on the garments of his sons with him; and he shall be holy, and his garments, and his sons, and the garments of his sons with him.
en.B: Then take a little of the blood on the altar and of the anointing oil, and spatter it on Aaron and his garments, and on his sons and their garments as well. In this way Aaron, his sons, and the garments they all wear will become holy.
en.R: Take a little of the blood from the altar and a little of the anointing oil. Sprinkle them on Aaron and his clothes, and on his sons and their clothes. This will make Aaron and his sons and their clothes holy.

es.L: Y tomarás de la sangre que [está] sobre el altar y del aceite de la unción, y [los] rociarás sobre Aarón y sobre sus vestiduras, y sobre sus hijos y sobre las vestiduras de sus hijos con él; y será santo él, y sus vestiduras, y sus hijos y las vestiduras de sus hijos con él.
es.B: Luego toma un poco de la sangre que está sobre el altar y del aceite de la unción, y rocíalos sobre Aarón y sus vestiduras, y también sobre sus hijos y sus vestiduras. Así Aarón, sus hijos y las vestiduras que llevan quedarán santificados.
es.R: Toma un poco de la sangre del altar y un poco del aceite de la unción. Rocíalos sobre Aarón y su ropa, y sobre sus hijos y su ropa. Esto hará santos a Aarón, a sus hijos y su ropa.

fr.L: Et tu prendras du sang qui [est] sur l’autel et de l’huile d’onction, et tu [en] aspergeras Aaron et ses vêtements, et ses fils et les vêtements de ses fils avec lui ; et il sera saint, lui et ses vêtements, et ses fils et les vêtements de ses fils avec lui.
fr.B: Prends ensuite un peu du sang qui est sur l’autel et de l’huile d’onction, et asperges-en Aaron et ses vêtements, ainsi que ses fils et leurs vêtements. Ainsi Aaron, ses fils et les vêtements qu’ils portent deviendront saints.
fr.R: Prends un peu du sang de l’autel et un peu d’huile d’onction. Asperges-en Aaron et ses vêtements, ainsi que ses fils et leurs vêtements. Cela rendra saints Aaron, ses fils et leurs vêtements.

sw.L: Nawe utachukua sehemu ya damu iliyo juu ya madhabahu na sehemu ya mafuta ya kupaka, na [kuvi]nyunyiza juu ya Haruni na juu ya mavazi yake, na juu ya wanawe na juu ya mavazi ya wanawe pamoja naye; naye atakuwa mtakatifu, yeye na mavazi yake, na wanawe na mavazi ya wanawe pamoja naye.
sw.B: Kisha chukua kiasi kidogo cha damu iliyo juu ya madhabahu na cha mafuta ya kupaka, uvinyunyize juu ya Haruni na mavazi yake, na juu ya wanawe na mavazi yao pia. Kwa njia hiyo Haruni na wanawe watakuwa watakatifu, na mavazi yao yatakuwa matakatifu.
sw.R: Chukua damu kidogo kutoka madhabahuni na mafuta kidogo ya kupaka. Vinyunyize juu ya Haruni na mavazi yake, na juu ya wanawe na mavazi yao. Hilo litawafanya Haruni na wanawe kuwa watakatifu, pamoja na mavazi yao.

decisions.choice: spatter: sprinkle in drops
decisions.reason: This verb is used for sprinkling small amounts, often with the finger (Leviticus 4:6; 8:30), unlike the verb "splash" in verse 20.

decisions.choice: he will be holy: he and his garments belong to God
decisions.reason: Blood from the altar and holy oil together set the priests and their garments apart for God's service. Leviticus 8:30 tells how it was done.

decisions.choice: "asperger"
decisions.reason: This verb sprinkles a few drops; French keeps "asperger" for it and "jeter" or "projeter" for throwing the blood against the altar (verses 16, 20), as in Leviticus.

source.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ מִן־הָ֠אַיִל הַחֵ֨לֶב וְהָֽאַלְיָ֜ה וְאֶת־הַחֵ֣לֶב׀הַֽמְכַסֶּ֣ה אֶת־הַקֶּ֗רֶב וְאֵ֨ת יֹתֶ֤רֶת הַכָּבֵד֙ וְאֵ֣ת׀שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֗ת וְאֶת־הַחֵ֨לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵהֶ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת שׁ֣וֹק הַיָּמִ֑ין כִּ֛י אֵ֥יל מִלֻּאִ֖ים הֽוּא׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will take from the ram the fat and the fat tail and the fat [which] covers the entrails and the lobe of the liver and the two kidneys and the fat which [is] on them and the thigh of the right, for a ram of ordination it [is],

en.L: And you shall take from the ram the fat and the fat tail, and the fat that covers the entrails, and the lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys and the fat that [is] on them, and the right thigh, for it [is] a ram of ordination,
en.B: Take the fat of this ram, its fat tail, the fat that covers the inner parts, the lobe of the liver, the two kidneys and the fat around them, and the right thigh, because this ram is the ram of ordination,
en.R: Take the fat from this ram: the fat tail, the fat around its insides, the piece that covers the liver, and the two kidneys with their fat. Also take the right thigh. This ram is for the ordination of the priests.

es.L: Y tomarás del carnero la grasa y la cola grasa, y la grasa que cubre las entrañas, y el lóbulo del hígado, y los dos riñones y la grasa que [está] sobre ellos, y el muslo derecho, porque [es] un carnero de investidura,
es.B: Toma la grasa de este carnero, su cola grasa, la grasa que cubre las vísceras, el lóbulo del hígado, los dos riñones con la grasa que los rodea, y el muslo derecho, porque este es el carnero de la investidura,
es.R: Saca la grasa de este carnero: la cola grasa, la grasa que rodea los órganos internos, el trozo que cubre el hígado y los dos riñones con su grasa. Toma también el muslo derecho. Este carnero es para la investidura de los sacerdotes.

fr.L: Et tu prendras du bélier la graisse et la queue grasse, et la graisse qui couvre les entrailles, et le lobe du foie, et les deux rognons et la graisse qui [est] sur eux, et la cuisse droite, car c’[est] un bélier d’investiture,
fr.B: Prends la graisse de ce bélier, sa queue grasse, la graisse qui enveloppe les viscères, le lobe du foie, les deux rognons avec la graisse qui les entoure, et la cuisse droite, car ce bélier est le bélier de l’investiture,
fr.R: Prends la graisse de ce bélier : la queue grasse, la graisse autour des organes du ventre, le morceau qui couvre le foie, et les deux rognons avec leur graisse. Prends aussi la cuisse droite. Ce bélier sert à l’investiture des prêtres.

sw.L: Nawe utachukua kutoka kwa kondoo dume shahamu na mkia mnono, na shahamu inayofunika matumbo, na kipande cha ini, na figo mbili na shahamu iliyo juu yake, na paja la kulia, kwa maana ni kondoo dume wa kusimikwa,
sw.B: Chukua shahamu ya kondoo dume huyu, mkia wake mnono, shahamu inayofunika viungo vya ndani, kipande cha ini, figo mbili pamoja na shahamu inayozizunguka, na paja la kulia, kwa sababu huyu ndiye kondoo dume wa kusimikwa,
sw.R: Chukua shahamu ya kondoo dume huyu: mkia mnono, shahamu inayozunguka viungo vya ndani, kipande kinachofunika ini, na figo mbili pamoja na shahamu yake. Chukua pia paja la kulia. Kondoo dume huyu ni kwa ajili ya kuwasimika makuhani.

decisions.choice: the fat tail: the broad, fatty tail of a sheep
decisions.reason: The sheep of the region had broad tails that stored fat, a choice part given to God on the altar (Leviticus 3:9).

decisions.choice: ordination: the filling, the installing of the priests
decisions.reason: The noun comes from the verb "fill" in "fill the hand" (verse 9). This ram is the offering by which the priests are installed (Leviticus 8:22).

decisions.choice: the right thigh: the upper part of the right hind leg
decisions.reason: In later fellowship offerings the right thigh is the priest's share (Leviticus 7:32-34). At the ordination it is burned on the altar (verse 25), "for it is a ram of ordination".

source.text: וְכִכַּ֨ר לֶ֜חֶם אַחַ֗ת וַֽחַלַּ֨ת לֶ֥חֶם שֶׁ֛מֶן אַחַ֖ת וְרָקִ֣יק אֶחָ֑ד מִסַּל֙ הַמַּצּ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: and one round loaf of bread and one cake of bread of oil and one wafer from [the] basket of the unleavened [bread] which [is] before Yahweh.

en.L: and one round loaf of bread, and one cake of oil bread, and one wafer, from the basket of the unleavened [bread] that [is] before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: along with one round loaf of bread, one loaf made with oil, and one wafer from the basket of unleavened bread that stands before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: From the basket of unleavened bread that is in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, take one loaf of plain bread, one loaf made with oil, and one thin wafer.

es.L: y una hogaza redonda de pan, y una torta de pan de aceite, y una oblea, del canastillo de los [panes] sin levadura que [está] delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: junto con una hogaza redonda de pan, un pan hecho con aceite y una oblea del canastillo de los panes sin levadura que está delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Del canastillo de pan sin levadura que está delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, toma un pan sencillo, un pan hecho con aceite y una oblea delgada.

fr.L: et une miche de pain, et un gâteau de pain à l’huile, et une galette, de la corbeille des [pains] sans levain qui [est] devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: ainsi qu’une miche ronde de pain, un pain fait à l’huile et une galette, pris dans la corbeille des pains sans levain placée devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Dans la corbeille de pain sans levain qui est devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, prends un pain ordinaire, un pain fait avec de l’huile et une fine galette.

sw.L: na mkate mmoja wa mviringo, na mkate mmoja wa mafuta, na mkate mmoja mwembamba, kutoka katika kikapu cha [mikate] isiyotiwa chachu kilicho mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: pamoja na mkate mmoja wa mviringo, mkate mmoja uliotengenezwa kwa mafuta, na mkate mmoja mwembamba, kutoka katika kikapu cha mikate isiyotiwa chachu kilichowekwa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Kutoka katika kikapu cha mikate isiyotiwa chachu kilicho mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, chukua mkate mmoja wa kawaida, mkate mmoja uliotengenezwa kwa mafuta, na mkate mmoja mwembamba.

decisions.choice: the basket: the basket of verses 2-3
decisions.reason: One of each of the three kinds of bread described in verse 2 is taken from the basket.

decisions.choice: round loaf: a flat, round loaf of bread
decisions.reason: The word means something round, and is used of a round loaf, of a round weight (a talent), and of the plain of the Jordan.

source.text: וְשַׂמְתָּ֣ הַכֹּ֔ל עַ֚ל כַּפֵּ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְעַ֖ל כַּפֵּ֣י בָנָ֑יו וְהֵנַפְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֛ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will put the whole on [the] palms of Aaron and on [the] palms of his sons and wave them [as] a wave offering before Yahweh.

en.L: And you shall put all [of it] on the palms of Aaron and on the palms of his sons, and you shall wave them [as] a wave offering before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Set all of it on the open hands of Aaron and his sons, and present it to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with a waving motion as a wave offering.
en.R: Put all these things into the hands of Aaron and his sons. Then wave them before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as a wave offering, a gift lifted up to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Y pondrás todo sobre las palmas de Aarón y sobre las palmas de sus hijos, y los mecerás [como] ofrenda mecida delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Pon todo esto en las manos abiertas de Aarón y de sus hijos, y preséntalo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} meciéndolo, como ofrenda mecida.
es.R: Pon todas estas cosas en las manos de Aarón y de sus hijos. Luego mécelas delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} como ofrenda mecida, un regalo que se {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} presenta en alto.

fr.L: Et tu mettras le tout sur les paumes d’Aaron et sur les paumes de ses fils, et tu les balanceras [en] offrande balancée devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Pose tout cela sur les mains ouvertes d’Aaron et de ses fils, et présente-le {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} en le balançant, comme offrande balancée.
fr.R: Mets toutes ces choses dans les mains d’Aaron et de ses fils. Ensuite, balance-les devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} comme offrande balancée, un don qu’on {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} présente en l’élevant.

sw.L: Nawe utaviweka vyote juu ya viganja vya Haruni na juu ya viganja vya wanawe, na kuvitikisa [kuwa] sadaka ya kutikiswa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Weka vitu hivyo vyote katika mikono iliyokunjuliwa ya Haruni na wanawe, uvitoe kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa kuvitikisa, kuwa sadaka ya kutikiswa.
sw.R: Weka vitu hivi vyote mikononi mwa Haruni na wanawe. Kisha vitikise mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kama sadaka ya kutikiswa, yaani zawadi inayoinuliwa mbele zake.

decisions.choice: wave: present to God with a motion of the hands
decisions.reason: The verb means to move something to and fro or to lift it up. The motion, perhaps toward the altar and back, showed that the gift was given to God. The exact movement is not known.

decisions.choice: you will wave them: Moses, while the gifts rest on the priests' hands
decisions.reason: Moses places the gifts on the priests' palms and he himself waves them (Leviticus 8:27). The priests' hands are filled, as the idiom "fill the hand" says (verse 9).

decisions.choice: a gift lifted up to him
decisions.reason: Readable explains what a wave offering is.

decisions.choice: "mecer"; "ofrenda mecida"
decisions.reason: The verb names a to-and-fro motion of the hands before God. "Mecer" keeps that picture, and "ofrenda mecida" names the offering after it at every level; Readable adds what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "balancer"; "offrande balancée"
alternatives: présenter par un geste de présentation
decisions.reason: The verb names a to-and-fro motion of the hands before God. "Balancer" keeps that picture, and "offrande balancée" names the offering after it at every level; Readable adds what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "kutikisa"; "sadaka ya kutikiswa"
decisions.reason: The verb names a to-and-fro motion of the hands before God. "Kutikisa" keeps that picture, and "sadaka ya kutikiswa" keeps it apart from "sadaka ya kuinuliwa", the contribution of verses 27-28.

source.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ֤ אֹתָם֙ מִיָּדָ֔ם וְהִקְטַרְתָּ֥ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חָה עַל־הָעֹלָ֑ה לְרֵ֤יחַ נִיח֨וֹחַ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אִשֶּׁ֥ה ה֖וּא לַיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will take them from their hand and make [them] smoke on the altar on the burnt offering, for an aroma of soothing before Yahweh; an offering by fire it [is] to Yahweh.

en.L: And you shall take them from their hand and make [them] smoke on the altar on the burnt offering, for an aroma of soothing before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; it [is] an offering by fire to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Afterward take these from their hands and send them up in smoke on the altar, on top of the burnt offering, as an aroma pleasing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. This is an offering by fire to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Then take these things from their hands and burn them on the altar, on top of the burnt offering. Their smell will please {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. It is an offering burned with fire for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y los tomarás de su mano, y [los] harás humear sobre el altar, sobre el holocausto, como aroma grato delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; [es] una ofrenda quemada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: Después tómalos de sus manos y hazlos subir en humo sobre el altar, encima del holocausto, como aroma grato {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Es una ofrenda quemada {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: Luego toma estas cosas de sus manos y quémalas en el altar, encima del holocausto. Su olor agradará {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Es una ofrenda quemada en el fuego para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et tu les prendras de leur main, et tu [les] feras fumer sur l’autel, sur l’holocauste, en odeur apaisante devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; c’[est] une offrande consumée par le feu pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Ensuite, reprends-les de leurs mains et fais-les monter en fumée sur l’autel, par-dessus l’holocauste, en odeur apaisante pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. C’est une offrande consumée par le feu pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Puis reprends ces choses de leurs mains et brûle-les sur l’autel, par-dessus l’holocauste. Leur odeur plaira {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. C’est une offrande brûlée sur le feu pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Nawe utavichukua kutoka mikononi mwao, na [kuvi]fukiza juu ya madhabahu, juu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, kuwa harufu ya kupendeza mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Kisha vichukue kutoka mikononi mwao uvifukize juu ya madhabahu, juu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, kuwa harufu ya kupendeza kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Ni sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa moto kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Kisha vichukue kutoka mikononi mwao uvichome juu ya madhabahu, juu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa. Harufu yake itampendeza {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Ni sadaka iliyochomwa kwa moto kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: on the burnt offering: on top of the ram already burning
decisions.reason: The first ram was burned whole as the burnt offering (verse 18). The fat, the thigh and the bread of the second ram are laid on top of it.

decisions.choice: an aroma of soothing: an offering God accepts
decisions.reason: As in verse 18.

source.text: וְלָקַחְתָּ֣ אֶת־הֶֽחָזֶ֗ה מֵאֵ֤יל הַמִּלֻּאִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאַהֲרֹ֔ן וְהֵנַפְתָּ֥ אֹת֛וֹ תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְהָיָ֥ה לְךָ֖ לְמָנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will take the breast from [the] ram of the ordination which [is] for Aaron and wave it [as] a wave offering before Yahweh, and it will be to you as a portion.

en.L: And you shall take the breast from the ram of ordination that [is] for Aaron, and wave it [as] a wave offering before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; and it shall be your portion.
en.B: Then take the breast from the ram used to ordain Aaron, and present it to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as a wave offering. That piece is to be your share.
en.R: Take the breast of the ram used to make Aaron a priest, and wave it before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as a wave offering. This part will be yours.

es.L: Y tomarás el pecho del carnero de la investidura que [es] para Aarón, y lo mecerás [como] ofrenda mecida delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}; y será tu porción.
es.B: Luego toma el pecho del carnero con el que se inviste a Aarón, y preséntalo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} como ofrenda mecida. Esa pieza será tu parte.
es.R: Toma el pecho del carnero que sirvió para hacer sacerdote a Aarón, y mécelo delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} como ofrenda mecida. Esta parte será para ti.

fr.L: Et tu prendras la poitrine du bélier d’investiture qui [est] pour Aaron, et tu la balanceras [en] offrande balancée devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; et elle sera ta part.
fr.B: Prends ensuite la poitrine du bélier qui a servi à l’investiture d’Aaron, et présente-la {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} comme offrande balancée. Ce morceau sera ta part.
fr.R: Prends la poitrine du bélier qui a servi à faire d’Aaron un prêtre, et balance-la devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} comme offrande balancée. Ce morceau sera pour toi.

sw.L: Nawe utachukua kidari cha kondoo dume wa kusimikwa aliye kwa ajili ya Haruni, na kukitikisa [kuwa] sadaka ya kutikiswa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; nacho kitakuwa fungu lako.
sw.B: Kisha chukua kidari cha kondoo dume aliyetumika kumsimika Haruni, ukitoe kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuwa sadaka ya kutikiswa. Kipande hicho kitakuwa fungu lako.
sw.R: Chukua kidari cha kondoo dume aliyetumika kumfanya Haruni kuwa kuhani, ukitikise mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kama sadaka ya kutikiswa. Sehemu hii itakuwa yako.

decisions.choice: which is for Aaron: the ram for Aaron's ordination
decisions.reason: The ram is offered for Aaron and his sons, to ordain them.

decisions.choice: your portion: Moses' share, as the one who serves as priest
decisions.reason: Moses carries out the priest's duties at the ordination, so he receives the priest's share, the breast (Leviticus 8:29). Later the breast goes to Aaron and his sons (verses 27-28; Leviticus 7:31).

source.text: וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֞ אֵ֣ת׀חֲזֵ֣ה הַתְּנוּפָ֗ה וְאֵת֙ שׁ֣וֹק הַתְּרוּמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר הוּנַ֖ף וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר הוּרָ֑ם מֵאֵיל֙ הַמִּלֻּאִ֔ים מֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּמֵאֲשֶׁ֥ר לְבָנָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will consecrate the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the contribution, which was waved and which was raised, from [the] ram of the ordination, from [that] which [is] for Aaron and from [that] which [is] for his sons.

en.L: And you shall consecrate the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the heave offering, which was waved and which was raised up, from the ram of ordination, from what [is] Aaron's and from what [is] his sons'.
en.B: Consecrate the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the contribution, the parts of the ram of ordination that were waved and lifted up, the share that belongs to Aaron and his sons.
en.R: Set apart as holy the breast and the thigh of the ram used for ordination. These are the parts that are waved and lifted up to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and they belong to Aaron and his sons.

es.L: Y consagrarás el pecho de la ofrenda mecida y el muslo de la ofrenda alzada, lo que fue mecido y lo que fue alzado del carnero de la investidura, de lo que [es] de Aarón y de lo que [es] de sus hijos.
es.B: Consagra el pecho de la ofrenda mecida y el muslo de la contribución, las piezas del carnero de la investidura que fueron mecidas y alzadas, la parte que corresponde a Aarón y a sus hijos.
es.R: Aparta como santos el pecho y el muslo del carnero de la investidura. Son las partes que se mecen y se alzan delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y pertenecen a Aarón y a sus hijos.

fr.L: Et tu consacreras la poitrine de l’offrande balancée et la cuisse de l’offrande élevée, ce qui a été balancé et ce qui a été élevé du bélier d’investiture, de ce qui [est] à Aaron et de ce qui [est] à ses fils.
fr.B: Consacre la poitrine de l’offrande balancée et la cuisse de la contribution, les morceaux du bélier de l’investiture qui ont été balancés et élevés, la part qui revient à Aaron et à ses fils.
fr.R: Mets à part comme saintes la poitrine et la cuisse du bélier de l’investiture. Ce sont les morceaux qu’on balance et qu’on élève devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et ils appartiennent à Aaron et à ses fils.

sw.L: Nawe utakitakasa kidari cha sadaka ya kutikiswa na paja la sadaka ya kuinuliwa, kilichotikiswa na lililoinuliwa, kutoka kwa kondoo dume wa kusimikwa, kutoka kile kilicho cha Haruni na kile kilicho cha wanawe.
sw.B: Takasa kidari cha sadaka ya kutikiswa na paja la mchango, yaani sehemu za kondoo dume wa kusimikwa zilizotikiswa na kuinuliwa, fungu ambalo ni la Haruni na wanawe.
sw.R: Tenga kidari na paja la kondoo dume wa kusimikwa kuwa vitu vitakatifu. Hivi ndivyo vipande vinavyotikiswa na kuinuliwa mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, navyo ni mali ya Haruni na wanawe.

decisions.choice: contribution: a part lifted off and set aside for God
decisions.reason: The noun comes from the verb "raise" or "lift off" used later in this verse. It names a portion taken from a larger whole and given to God, which God then gives to the priests. It was formerly rendered "heave offering".

decisions.choice: consecrate ... which was waved and raised: a rule for the future
decisions.reason: At the ordination the thigh was burned (verses 22, 25), so verses 27-28 look ahead. From now on, the breast and the thigh of such offerings are holy and belong to the priests (Leviticus 7:31-34; 10:14-15).

decisions.choice: lifted up to the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable says to whom the parts are waved and lifted, as in verses 24 and 26.

source.text: וְהָיָה֩ לְאַהֲרֹ֨ן וּלְבָנָ֜יו לְחָק־עוֹלָ֗ם מֵאֵת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ֥י תְרוּמָ֖ה ה֑וּא וּתְרוּמָ֞ה יִהְיֶ֨ה מֵאֵ֤ת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִזִּבְחֵ֣י שַׁלְמֵיהֶ֔ם תְּרוּמָתָ֖ם לַיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be for Aaron and for his sons as a due of perpetuity from with [the] sons of Israel, for a contribution it [is]; and a contribution it will be from with [the] sons of Israel from [the] sacrifices of their peace offerings, their contribution to Yahweh.

en.L: And it shall be for Aaron and for his sons as a due forever from the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel, for it [is] a heave offering; and a heave offering it shall be from the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel, from their sacrifices of peace offerings, their heave offering to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: This will be the lasting share that Aaron and his sons receive from the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}. It is a contribution: whenever the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} sacrifice fellowship offerings, this part is their contribution to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
